name: Inkscape CLI
description: Reference SVG renderer used by export-png.sh. Resolved from $INKSCAPE, then PATH, then the macOS app bundle.

name: playwright-core + Chromium
description: Headless Chromium used by compare-sheet.mjs through ecosystem-assets' scripts/lib/render.mjs; installed and pinned in ecosystem-assets, not here.

name: sips
description: macOS built-in image tool; export-png.sh uses it to report output size and alpha. Not available on other platforms.

name: Git
description: Version control CLI. differential-review reads history with git diff, log and blame.
